## 3. Checks done

- [ ] Trial or sandbox used, with the result.
- [ ] Pricing read on the vendor's page, with the date.
- [ ] Data processing terms read; sub-processors listed.
- [ ] Exit path tested or described step by step.
- [ ] The monthly cost added to the cost sheet.
